governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with the team’s organisational, workforce and professional-practice arrangements governed through the relevant Digital and IT forums.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the team’s remit, staffing and capacity, leadership and decision rights, demand intake and prioritisation, the evidence the first year must generate about team shape and institutional capability, any material increase in the first-year Hub scope that would compete with the King’s Edge roadmap, product and delivery practices, interfaces with specialist Digital and IT functions, evidence-based decisions to expand the team, handover criteria and enduring institutional ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – Digital and IT product development capability owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: The capability is expected to sit within Digital and IT, but its enduring organisational home, recurrent staffing, professional leadership and relationship to the Student Experience Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 should be confirmed as the operating model is proven. During 2026/27, the four-person core and one shared pipeline are the planning baseline. King’s Edge remains the principal substantive product demand and the September 2027 Hub is a focused first live release. Any material expansion in integration depth or team size should follow evidence from delivery and live use.
